thread:
Ruth: Flagging Vireo Diagnostics beta - 8 seats enrolled but only 2 active devs. Renewal conversation starts 5 weeks after beta end. Want a runbook to re-engage.
Diego: Ack. What roles are quiet?
Ruth: 2 PMs, 4 data analysts mostly dormant. Engineers tested an integration sample.
Nina: Propose "office hours" (45m) split: 20m demo, 20m hands-on pairing, 5m next steps. Also send a 3-question micro-survey to identify blockers.
Diego: +1. Survey Qs: 1) primary blocker? 2) prefer office hours or pairing? 3) useful time slots? Keep it <30s.
Ruth: Good. Risk: medium-high. If no +3 active users within 10 days after sessions, escalate to AE for renewal prep.
Nina: I'll prepare a lightweight analyst notebook and two quick integration snippets. Can share sandbox creds.
cs-bot: Sandbox account created: vireo-beta-sandbox (ttl 12d).
Diego: I'll draft outreach copy and calendar invite. Also add an optional checkbox: request a 1:1 engineering pairing.
Ruth: Outreach draft (please edit):
```
Hi team - quick check: we noticed some roles haven't had a chance to use the beta. Would a 45m office hours session or a 1:1 pairing be helpful? Pick a slot here: <cal.link/vireo-office>
```
Nina: Agenda for office hours: 1) 5m success metrics, 2) 20m demo (prompts + embed flows), 3) 15m hands-on pairing, 4) 5m next steps.
Diego: Owners: Diego - send survey + invite today. Nina - notebook + snippets by EOD. Ruth - update playbook and monitor activity.
Ruth: Playbook template to paste: 
```
Outcome: attended / no-show / follow-up scheduled
Active seats after: (n)
Top blockers: (list)
Agreed success metric: (e.g., 3 active users within 10 days)
Escalation: AE + eng pairing if not met
Owner + due date:
```
Diego: Survey sent. One reply preferring pairing. Scheduled a 1:1 with their analyst for Thurs 4pm.
Nina: Sharing notebook link in #cs-assets. Will tailor to their schema before the 1:1.
Ruth: If post-pairing we still don't see the lift, plan B = ship a tailored integration PR with their team (eng time boxed). Tagging for escalation.
Diego: I'll update Gainsight renewal risk if we miss the metric.
Ruth: Thanks team, keep updates here and paste final notes into the playbook. :white_check_mark:
